name: loggraph
description: Perfetto-style log timeline analyzer with multi-filter correlation

scripts.build:wasm: cd filter-wasm && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/filter_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir ../src/filters/wasm-filter/pkg --out-name filter_wasm
scripts.build:wasm:cep: cd cep-wasm && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cep_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir ../src/sequence/wasm-cep/pkg --out-name cep_wasm
